annotation.title_clean: Working paper submitted by Finland, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, Spain, and Sweden to the 2022 Chair of the GGE on emerging technologies in the area of lethal autonomous weapons systems
annotation.title_en: Working paper submitted by Finland, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, Spain, and Sweden to the 2022 Chair of the GGE on emerging technologies in the area of lethal autonomous weapons systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Finland, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, Spain, Sweden
annotation.venue: UN CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS
annotation.summary_en: Joint working paper by seven European states proposing a structure for GGE recommendations on lethal autonomous weapons: a two-tier approach that outlaws fully autonomous weapons outside human control and a chain of command, and regulates other autonomous-featured weapons through IHL compliance, human control, accountability and risk mitigation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Two-tier approach: prohibit LAWS that cannot comply with IHL; regulate other autonomous weapons
Commit not to develop or use fully autonomous weapons outside human control and responsible command
Legal reviews and testing/certification across the system life cycle
Appropriate human control: foreseeability, spatial/temporal limits, ability to deactivate
Human responsibility never transferable to machines; training, after-action review, investigation and prosecution
